knownVariances.description: Design tokens define HSL and CSS custom property primitives; browser rasterization exhibits natural subpixel variance against SVG vector shapes.
knownVariances.justification: CSS custom property variables enforce exact semantic color codes; display pixel differences are non-semantic antialiasing.

knownVariances.description: Mobile screen (<640px) uses accessible collapsible modal drawer triggered by fixed hamburger button rather than horizontal shrink.
knownVariances.justification: Required by WCAG 2.5.8 touch target ergonomics and responsive layout specifications.

entries.name: Wallet Connection, Network Selector & Identity Entry

knownVariances.description: Mocked test wallet renders deterministic checksum address 0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f0eB1E instead of live injected signer.
knownVariances.justification: Ensures reproducible clean CI execution without relying on browser wallet extensions or live keyrings.

knownVariances.description: SVG vector typography in approved design authority renders with subpixel differences compared to browser webfont glyph rasterization at 1440px.
knownVariances.justification: Approved browser typography uses Inter with font-smoothing; vector SVG rasterizer antialiasing varies by subpixel renderer.
